topics.title: Yemen mein Hukoomat

paragraphs.text: Islam se pehle ke Arabon ke baare mein baat karte huye, hum zaroori samajhte hain ke Arabon ki hukoomat, sardaari, firqa-bandi aur mazhabi ghalbe ki taareekh ki ek mukhtasar tasveer pesh ki jaaye, taa-ke Islam ke zuhoor ke waqt paida hone waale haalaat ko samajhna aasaan ho jaaye.

Jab Islam ka sooraj tulu hua, to Arab ke hukmaraan do qism ke the: taajdaar baadshah, jo haqeeqat mein khud-mukhtaar nahin the; aur qabail aur khaandaano ke sardaar, jo wohi ikhtiyaaraat aur imtiyaazaat rakhte the jo taajdaar baadshahon ke paas the aur aksar khud-mukhtaar the, agarche un mein se baaz kisi taajdaar baadshah ki kuch had tak itaa'at zaahir karte the. Taajdaar baadshah sirf Yemen, Heerah aur Ghassan ke the. Arab ke baaqi tamaam hukmaraan be-taaj the.

Sheba ke log khaalis Arabon ki sab se qadeem qaumon mein se ek the, jo Yemen mein rehte the. "Or" mein khudaai (excavations) ne unki mojoodgi pachhees (25) sadiyaan qabl-e-maseeh saamne laayi. Unki tehzeeb phali phooli, aur unki saltanat gyarah (11) sadiyaan qabl-e-maseeh phail gayi.

Unke daur ko darj-zail andaaze ke mutaabiq taqseem kiya ja sakta hai. 650 B.C. se pehle ki sadiyaan, jin ke douraan unke baadshahon ko "Makrib Sheba" kaha jaata tha. Unka daar-ul-hukoomat "Sarwah" tha, jo "Khriba" ke naam se bhi maaroof tha, jis ke khandraat ek aise maqaam par hain jo "Ma'rib" ke maghribi janib se ek din ki paidal masaafat par hai. Is douraan, unhon ne "Dam of Ma'rib" (Ma'rib ka bandh) banaana shuru kiya jo Yemen ki taareekh mein bahut ahmiyat rakhta tha. Sheba ke baare mein yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke unki itni badi saltanat thi ke Arab ke andar aur baahar unki colonies (basaaiyaan) theen.

650 B.C. se 115 B.C. tak. Is daur mein, unhon ne "Makrib" ka naam chhod diya aur "Kings of Sheba" (Sheba ke baadshah) ka khitaab ikhtiyaar kiya. Unhon ne Sarwah ke bajaaye Ma'rib ko apna daar-ul-hukoomat banaaya. Ma'rib ke khandraat San'a se saath (60) meel mashriq mein hain.

115 B.C. se 300 A.D. tak. Is daur mein, Himyar ke qabeele ne Sheba ki saltanat fatah kar li aur Ma'rib ke bajaaye Redan ko daar-ul-hukoomat banaaya. Baad mein, Redan ko "Zifar" kaha gaya. Iske khandraat aaj bhi "Yarim" shehr ke qareeb Mudawwar pahaad par hain. Is daur mein, unka zawaal shuru hua. Unki tijaarat bahut had tak nakaam ho gayi, awwal, Hijaz ke shumaal par Nabetean ghalbe ki wajah se; doosra, Misr, Syria aur Hijaz ke shumaal ki Roman fatah ke baad bahri tijaarati raahon par Roman bartari ki wajah se; aur teesra, baahami qabaili jangon ki wajah se. Upar bayaan kiye gaye teen awaamil ki wajah se, Qahtan ke khaandaan bikhar gaye aur muntashir ho gaye.

300 A.D. se le kar Yemen par Islam ke tulu hone tak. Is daur mein bahut intishaar aur ho-hangaama dekhne ko mila. Kasrat se khaana-jangiyon ne Yemen ke logon ko ghair-mulki ghulaami ka shikaar bana diya aur is tarah unki khud-mukhtaari khatam ho gayi. Is daur mein, Romiyon ne 'Adn ko fatah kiya aur yahaan tak ke Abyssiniyon (Ethiopians) ki madad ki ke woh 340 A.D. mein pehli baar Yemen par qabza karein, Hamdan aur Himyar ke musalsal baahami qabaili tasaadum se faayda uthaate huye. Yemen par Abyssinian (Ethiopian) qabza 378 A.D. tak rahaa, jis ke baad Yemen ne apni khud-mukhtaari dobaara haasil kar li.

Baad mein, Ma'rib Dam mein daraarein zaahir hone lageen jis ki wajah se woh Bada Sailaab (450 ya 451 A.D.) aaya jis ka zikr Qur'an-e-Kareem mein hai. Yeh ek bada waaqia tha jis ne poori Yemeni tehzeeb ke zawaal aur wahaan basne waali qaumon ke bikhaaru ka sabab bana.

523 mein, Dhu Nawas, jo ek Yahoodi tha, ne Najran ke Isaaiyon ke khilaaf ek badi muhim bheji taa-ke unhein Yahudiyat qubool karne par majboor kar sake. Jab unhon ne aisa karne se inkaar kar diya, to unhein zinda ek badi khandaq mein phenk diya gaya jahaan badi aag jalaai gayi thi. Qur'an ne is waaqie ki taraf ishaara kiya. "Cursed were the people of the ditch." [85:4]

Is se Isaaiyon mein, aur khaaskar Roman baadshahon mein, bada ghussa paida hua, jinhon ne na sirf Abyssiniyon (Ethiopians) ko Arabon ke khilaaf bharkaaya balke ek bada bedaa (fleet) bhi jama kiya jis ne Abyssinian (Ethiopian) fauj ki, jo sattar hazaar (70,000) jangjuon par mushtamil thi, 525 A.D. mein Yemen ki doosri fatah mein madad ki, Eriat ki qiyaadat mein, jise Yemen par hukoomat di gayi, ek aisa ohda jo us ne apni fauj ke ek leader, Abraha, ke haathon qatl hone tak rakkha, jis ne, Abyssinia ke baadshah se sulah karne ke baad, Yemen par hukoomat le li aur, baad mein, apne sipaahiyon ko Al-Ka'bah dhaane ke liye rawaana kiya, aur is tarah, woh aur uske sipaahi "Men of the Elephant" (Ashaab-ul-Feel) ke naam se jaane gaye.

"Elephant" (Feel) waaqie ke baad, Yemen ke logon ne, Ma'dikarib bin Saif Dhu Yazin Al-Himyari ki qiyaadat mein, aur Persian (Faarsi) madad se, Abyssinian (Ethiopian) hamla-aawaron ke khilaaf baghaawat ki, khud-mukhtaari bahaal ki aur Ma'dikarib ko apna baadshah muqarrar kiya. Magar, Ma'dikarib ko ek aise Abyssinian (Ethiopian) ne qatl kar diya jise woh apni khidmat aur hifaazat ke liye apne paas rakha karta tha. Dhu Yazin ka khaandaan is tarah hamesha ke liye baadshaahat se mehroom ho gaya.

Kisra, jo Persian (Faarsi) baadshah tha, ne San'a par ek Persian (Faarsi) hukmaraan muqarrar kiya aur is tarah Yemen ko ek Persian (Faarsi) colony bana diya. Persian (Faarsi) hukmaraano ne Yemen ki hukoomat us waqt tak qaaim rakhi jab tak un mein se aakhri, Badhan ne 638 A.D. mein Islam qubool kar liya, is tarah Yemen par Persian (Faarsi) ghalba khatam ho gaya.

topics.topicSummary: Yemen ki hukoomat chaar bade adwaar se guzri — qadeem Sheba tehzeeb aur Ma'rib Dam ke daur se le kar, Himyar ke uruj aur zawaal, do Abyssinian qabzon, aur aakhir mein Persian (Faarsi) colony banne tak — yahaan tak ke Islam ne ghair-mulki ghalbe ko khatam kar diya jab aakhri Persian (Faarsi) gavarnar, Badhan ne 638 A.D. mein Islam qubool kar liya.

topics.title: Heerah mein Hukoomat

paragraphs.text: Jab se Korosh the Great (557-529 B.C.) ne Persianon (Faarsiyon) ko muttahid kiya, unhon ne Iraq aur uske ird-gird hukoomat ki. Koi bhi unki itaa'at se nahin nikal saka jab tak Alexander the Great ne unke baadshah Dara I ko shikast nahin di aur is tarah 326 B.C. mein Persianon (Faarsiyon) ko zer kiya. Persian (Faarsi) ilaaqe is ke baad taqseem ho gaye aur un baadshahon ke haathon hukoomat hone lagi jo "the Kings of Sects" (firqon ke baadshah) ke naam se jaane jaate the, ek aisa daur jo 230 A.D. tak rahaa. Isi douraan, Qahtaniyon ne kuch Iraqi ilaaqe par qabza kar liya, aur unke baad kuch 'Adnaniyon ne bhi un ke saath Mesopotamia ke kuch hisse mein shareek hone mein kaamyaabi haasil ki.

Persianon (Faarsiyon) ne, Ardashir ki qiyaadat mein, jis ne 226 A.D. mein Sasanian riyaasat qaaim ki thi, kaafi ittehaad aur taaqat dobaara haasil kar li ke woh apni saltanat ke ird-gird rehne waale Arabon ko zer kar sakein, aur Quda'a ko Syria ki taraf jaane par majboor karein, Heerah aur Anbar ke logon ko Persian (Faarsi) ghalbe ke neeche chhod kar.

Ardashir ke daur mein, Juzaima Alwaddah Heerah, Rabi'a aur Mudar, aur Mesopotamia par hukoomat karta tha. Ardashir ne andaaza lagaaya tha ke uske liye Arabon par seedha hukoomat karna aur unhein apni sarhadon par hamla karne se rokna mumkin nahin jab tak woh un mein se kisi ek ko baadshah muqarrar na kare jo apne qabeele ki himaayat aur taaqat rakhta ho. Us ne yeh bhi dekha tha ke woh unhein Byzantine baadshahon ke khilaaf istemaal kar sakta hai jo hamesha use tang kiya karte the. Isi waqt, Iraq ke Arab un Syria ke Arabon ka muqaabla kar sakte the jo Byzantine baadshahon ke qabze mein the. Magar, us ne munaasib samajha ke Heerah ke baadshah ki command mein ek Persian (Faarsi) battalion rakhe jise un Arabon ke khilaaf istemaal kiya jaaye jo us ke khilaaf baghaawat karein.

Juzaima ki maut ke baad takreeban 268 A.D. mein, 'Amr bin 'Adi bin Nasr Al-Lakhmi ko Persian (Faarsi) baadshah Sabour bin Ardashir ne baadshah muqarrar kiya. 'Amr Lakhmi baadshahon mein pehla tha jis ne Heerah par hukoomat ki jab tak Persianon (Faarsiyon) ne Qabaz bin Fairuz ko muqarrar nahin kiya jis ke daur mein Mazdak naami ek shakhs zaahir hua, jo zindagi mein be-raah-rawi (badkaari) ki daawat deta tha. Qabaz, aur uske bahut se ra'aaya, ne Mazdak ka mazhab qubool kar liya aur yahaan tak ke Heerah ke baadshah, Al-Munzir bin Ma' As-Sama' ko bhi peechhe chalne ki daawat di. Jab us (Munzir) ne, apni khud-daari aur izzat-e-nafs ki wajah se, unke hukm ko thukra diya, to Qabaz ne use mua'attal kar diya aur Harith bin 'Amr bin Hajar Al-Kindi ko naamzad kiya, jis ne Mazdaki aqeede ko qubool kar liya tha.

Kisra Anu Shairwan ke Qabaz ki jagah laete hi, us ne, Mazdak ke falsafe se nafrat ki wajah se, Mazdak aur uske bahut se pairokaaron ko qatl kar diya, Munzir ko Heerah ke takht par bahaal kiya aur Harith ko giraftaar karne ke ahkaamaat diye jis ne Al-Kalb qabeele mein panaah li jahaan us ne apni baaqi zindagi guzaari.

Al-Munzir bin Ma' As-Sama' ke beton ne badi muddat tak baadshaahat qaaim rakhi jab tak An-Nu'man bin Al-Munzir ne hukoomat sambhaal nahin li. Zaid bin 'Adi Al-'Abbadi ki ek jhooti tohmat ki wajah se, Persian (Faarsi) baadshah An-Nu'man se naaraaz ho gaya aur use apne mehel mein bula liya. An-Nu'man chupke se Hani bin Mas'ud, jo Shaiban qabeele ka sardaar tha, ke paas gaya, aur apni doulat aur khaandaan ko us (Hani) ki hifaazat mein chhod diya, aur phir Persian (Faarsi) baadshah ke saamne haazir hua, jis ne foran use jail mein daal diya jahaan woh halaak ho gaya.

Kisra ne, phir, Eyas bin Qubaisa At-Ta'i ko Heerah ka baadshah muqarrar kiya. Eyas ko hukm diya gaya ke woh Hani bin Mas'ud se kahe ke An-Nu'man ki amaanat Kisra ke hawaale kar de. Persian (Faarsi) baadshah ko Arab sardaar ki taraf se ta'assub-bhara inkaar milte hi, us ne Shaiban qabeele ke khilaaf jang ka elaan kar diya aur apne lashkar aur jangjuon ko King Eyas ki qiyaadat mein Dhee Qar naam ki ek jagah ki taraf rawaana kiya jahaan ek nihaayat sakht jang dekhne ko mili jis mein Persianon (Faarsiyon) ko Arabon ke haathon taareekh mein pehli baar sakht shikast hui. Yeh Nabi Muhammad [pbuh] ki paidaaish ke bahut jald baad tha, Eyas bin Qubaisah ke Heerah par hukoomat sambhaalne ke aath maheene baad.

Eyas ke baad, Heerah par ek Persian (Faarsi) hukmaraan muqarrar kiya gaya, magar 632 A.D. mein wahaan hukoomat Lukhm ke khaandaan ko wapas mil gayi jab Al-Munzir Al-Ma'rur ne hukoomat sambhaali. Us ka daur abhi mushkil se aath maheene hi rahaa tha ke Khalid bin Al-Waleed Muslim sipaahiyon ke saath us par tooT pade.

topics.topicSummary: Heerah ek Arab saltanat thi jo Persian (Faarsi) saaye mein thi, jis par Lakhmi baadshahon ne Persian (Faarsi) numaainde ke taur par hukoomat ki taa-ke Arab qabail ko sambhaalein aur Byzantine asar ka muqaabla karein. Iski taareekh Persian (Faarsi) muqarrar-kardah hukmaraano, intishaar-pasand Mazdak bid'at, aur aakhir mein Dhee Qar ki jang — Persianon par pehli taareekhi Arab fatah — se bharpoor thi jo Nabi ﷺ ki paidaaish ke jald baad hui.

topics.title: Jughraafiyaai Syria mein Hukoomat

paragraphs.text: Qabaili hijraton ke amal mein, Quda'a ke kuch shoabe (septs) Syria ki sarhadon tak pahunche jahaan woh aabaad ho gaye. Woh Sulaih bin Halwan ke khaandaan se ta'alluq rakhte the, jin ki nasl mein Duj'am bin Sulaih ke bete the jo Ad-Duja'ima ke naam se jaane jaate the. Quda'a ke aise shoabe Byzantines ki taraf se Byzantine sarhadon ki hifaazat mein Arab Bedouin (sehraai) hamla-aawaron aur Persianon (Faarsiyon) donon ke khilaaf istemaal hote the, aur ek kaafi arsay tak khud-mukhtaari ka mazaa lete rahe jis ke baare mein kaha jaata hai ke yeh poori doosri sadi A.D. tak rahi. Unke sab se mash-hoor baadshahon mein se ek Zyiad bin Al-Habula tha.

Magar unki hukoomat Ghassanides ke haathon shikast par khatam ho gayi jinhein natijatan Syria ke Arabon par numaainda hukoomat di gayi aur Dumat Al-Jandal unka markaz tha, jo 13 A.H. mein Yarmuk ki jang tak rahaa. Unke aakhri baadshah Jabala bin Al-Aihum ne Ameer-ul-Momineen, 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (Allah un se raazi ho) ke daur mein Islam qubool kiya.

topics.topicSummary: Quda'a ke kuch shoabe Syria mein Byzantine numaainda hukmaraano ke taur par aabaad huye jo sarhadon ki Arab hamla-aawaron aur Persia ke khilaaf hifaazat karte the. Aakhir-kaar unhein Ghassanides ne hata diya, jinhon ne Byzantine numaainde ke taur par hukoomat ki jab tak Yarmuk ki jang (13 A.H.) mein unki shikast nahin hui, jis ke baad unke aakhri baadshah ne Khalifa 'Umar ke daur mein Islam qubool kiya.

topics.title: Hijaz mein Hukoomat

paragraphs.text: Ismail (AS) ne apni poori zindagi Makkah par hukoomat ke saath-saath Bait-ul-Haraam ki tawalliyat (custodianship) bhi sambhaali. Unki wafaat par, 137 saal ki umr mein, unke do bete, Nabet aur Qidar, unke jaa-nasheen huye. Baad mein, unke naana, Mudad bin 'Amr Al-Jurhumi ne hukoomat sambhaal li, is tarah Makkah ki hukoomat Jurhum qabeele ko muntaqil ho gayi, Ismail ke beton ke liye ek baa-izzat maqaam, magar bahut kam ikhtiyaar mehfooz rakhte huye un ke waalid ke Bait-ul-Haraam ki taameer ke kaarnaamon ki wajah se, ek aisa maqaam jo unhon ne Jurhum qabeele ke zawaal tak rakkha jo Bukhtanassar ke uruj se thodi der pehle tha.

Makkah mein 'Adnaniyon ka siyaasi kirdaar mazboot bunyaadein haasil karne laga tha, jis ki wazaahat is haqeeqat se saaf zaahir hai ke Bukhtanassar ke Arabon par pehle hamle par 'Dhati 'Irq' mein, Arabon ka leader Jurhum se nahin tha.

Magar Bukhtanassar ke doosre hamle par 587 B.C. mein, 'Adnani Yemen ki taraf bhaag gaye, jab ke Burmia An-Nabi Ma'ad ke saath Syria bhaag gaya, magar jab Bukhtanassar ka dabaao kam hua, to Ma'ad Makkah wapas aaya aur Jurhum qabeele mein se siwaaye Jursham bin Jalhamah ke kisi ko nahin paaya, jis ki beti, Mu'ana, Ma'ad ko biwi ke taur par di gayi jis se baad mein us ke ek beta paida hua jis ka naam Nizar tha.

Makkah mein mushkil maeeshat aur ghurbat ki wajah se, Jurhum qabeela Bait-ul-Haraam ke aane waalon ke saath bura sulook karne aur uske amwaal hadap karne laga, jis se 'Adnaniyon (Bakr bin 'Abd Munaf bin Kinana ke beton) mein naaraazgi aur nafrat paida hui jinhon ne, Khuza'a qabeele ki madad se jo Marr Az-Zahran naam ke ek paados waale ilaaqe mein aa kar aabaad hua tha, Jurhum par hamla kiya aur unhein Makkah se bhaga diya, hukoomat Quda'a ko chhod kar doosri sadi A.D. ke wast mein.

Makkah chhodte waqt, Jurhum ne Zamzam ke kuwein ko bhar diya, uski jagah hamwaar kar di aur us mein bahut si cheezein dafan kar deen. 'Amr bin Al-Harith bin Mudad Al-Jurhumi ke baare mein Ibn Ishaq, jo mash-hoor moarrikh hai, ne bataaya hai ke us ne do sone ke hiran (gold deer) ke saath Hajr-e-Aswad aur bahut se zewaraat aur talwaarein Zamzam mein dafan keen, Yemen ki taraf apne dukh-bhare faraar se pehle.

Ismail ka daur takreeban bees (20) sadiyaan qabl-e-maseeh tak rahaa hone ka andaaza hai, jis ka matlab hai ke Jurhum Makkah mein ikkees (21) sadiyon tak rahe aur wahaan takreeban bees (20) sadiyon tak hukoomat ki.

Jurhum ki shikast par, Khuza'a qabeele ne Makkah par hukoomat par ekaada (monopoly) kar liya. Magar Mudar qabail ko teen imtiyaazaat haasil the: Pehla: Hujjaaj ko 'Arafat se Muzdalifah aur phir Mina se 'Aqabah ke Stoning Pillar (rami waale satoon) tak le jaana. Yeh Al-Ghawth bin Murra ke khaandaan ka ikhtiyaar tha, jo Elias bin Mudar ke shoabon mein se ek tha, jinhein 'Sofa' kaha jaata tha. Is imtiyaaz ka matlab tha ke hujjaaj ko Al-'Aqabah par patthar maarne ki ijaazat nahin thi jab tak 'Sofa' ka koi aadmi aisa na kare. Jab woh rami se faarigh hote aur Mina ki waadi se nikalna chaahte, to 'Sofa' ke aadmi Al-'Aqabah ke donon janib khade ho jaate aur koi us jagah se nahin guzarta jab tak 'Sofa' ke aadmi guzar na jaayein aur hujjaaj ke liye raasta saaf na kar dein. Jab Sofa khatam ho gaya, to Tamim qabeele se Sa'd bin Zaid Manat ke khaandaan ne yeh zimmedaari sambhaal li.

Doosra: Al-Ifadah (Muzdalifah ke baad Mina ke liye rawaangi) qurbaani ki subah, aur yeh Adwan ke khaandaan ki zimmedaari thi. Teesra: hurmat waale maheenon ko aage badhaana (nasi), aur yeh Bani Kinana mein se Tamim bin 'Adi ke khaandaan ki zimmedaari thi.

Makkah mein Khuza'a ka daur teen sau (300) saal tak rahaa, jis ke douraan, 'Adnani poore Najd aur Bahrain aur Iraq ke kinaaron par phail gaye, jab ke Quraish ke chhote shoabe Makkah ke kinaaron par rahe; woh Haloul, Harum aur Kinana ke kuch khaandaan the. Unhein Makkah mein ya Bait-ul-Haraam mein koi imtiyaazaat haasil nahin the jab tak Qusai bin Kilab zaahir na hua, jis ke waalid ke baare mein kaha jaata hai ke us waqt mar gaya jab woh abhi shir-khwaar bachcha tha, aur jis ki maa baad mein Rabi'a bin Haram se, Bani 'Udhra qabeele se, biyaah di gayi. Rabi'a apni biwi aur uske bachche ko Syria ki sarhadon par apne watan le gaya. Jab Qusai jawaan hua, to woh Makkah wapas aaya, jis par Khuza'a se Halil bin Habsha hukoomat karta tha, jis ne Qusai ko apni beti, Hobba, biwi ke taur par di. Halil ki maut ke baad, Khuza'a aur Quraish ke darmiyaan jang chhid gayi aur is ka natija Qusai ke Makkah aur Bait-ul-Haraam par qabze ki soorat mein nikla.

paragraphs.text: Pehli. Halil ki maut ke baad apni nasl ke phailaao, apni jaaidaad ke izaafe aur apni izzat ke buland hone ko dekhte huye, Qusai ne khud ko Makkah par hukoomat aur Bait-ul-Haraam ki tawalliyat ki zimmedaari uthaane ka Khuza'a aur Bani Bakr qabail se ziyaada haqdaar paaya. Us ne yeh bhi daleel di ke Quraish Ismail ki aulaad ke sardaar hain. Is liye us ne Quraish aur Kinana ke kuch aadmiyon se apni Khuza'a aur Bani Bakr ko Makkah se nikaalne ki khwaahish ke baare mein mashwara kiya. Unhein us ki raaye pasand aayi aur unhon ne us ki himaayat ki.
Doosri: Khuza'a ne daawa kiya ke Halil ne Qusai se darkhwaast ki thi ke apni maut ke baad Al-Ka'bah ki tawalliyat aur Makkah par hukoomat sambhaale.

Teesri. Halil ne Al-Ka'bah ki khidmat ka haq apni beti Hobba ko diya aur Abu Ghabshan Al-Khuza'i ko us ka wakeel muqarrar kiya. Halil ki maut par, Qusai ne yeh haq sharaab ke ek chamde ke thaile ke badle khareed liya, jis se Khuza'a ke aadmiyon mein be-itminaani paida hui aur unhon ne Bait-ul-Haraam ki tawalliyat ko Qusai se door rakhne ki koshish ki. Magar us (Qusai) ne, Quraish aur Kinana ki madad se, hukoomat sambhaalne aur yahaan tak ke Khuza'a ko Makkah se mukammal taur par nikaalne mein kaamyaabi haasil ki.

Haqeeqat jo bhi rahi ho, poora maamla Sofa ke unke imtiyaazaat se mehroomi, jin ka pehle zikr hua, Khuza'a aur Bakr ki Makkah se rawaangi aur Makkah par hukoomat aur Bait-ul-Haraam ki tawalliyat ke Qusai ko muntaqil hone par muntaj hua, Qusai aur Khuza'a ke darmiyaan sakht jangon ke baad jin mein donon taraf bhaari jaani nuqsaan hua, sulah aur phir Bakr qabeele se Ya'mur bin 'Awf ki salisi, jis ka faisla Qusai ki Makkah par hukoomat aur Bait-ul-Haraam ki tawalliyat ki ahliyat, Khuza'a ke khoon-bahaaye ke liye Qusai ki ghair-zimmedaari, aur Khuza'a par khoon-baha (diyat) ke nafaaz par mushtamil tha. Qusai ka Makkah aur Bait-ul-Haraam par daur 440 A.D. mein shuru hua aur us ne use, aur baad mein Quraish ko, Makkah par mutlaq hukoomat aur Bait-ul-Haraam ki be-tanaaza tawalliyat ki ijaazat di jis ko khiraaj-e-aqeedat pesh karne ke liye Arab poore Arab se aate the.

Qusai apne rishtedaaron ko Makkah laaya aur use un mein taqseem kiya, Quraish ko wahaan kuch makaanaat ki ijaazat dete huye. An-Nus'a, Safwan, Adwan, Murra bin 'Awf ke khaandaano ne wohi huqooq mehfooz rakhe jo woh us ki aamad se pehle rakhte the.

Qusai ko mansoob ek ahem kaarnaama Al-Ka'bah Mosque ke shumaali janib An-Nadwa House (ek dar-ul-nadwa, mushaawarati ghar) ki taameer thi, taa-ke Quraish ke liye ek jagah-e-mulaaqaat ki tarah kaam aaye. Isi ghar ne Quraish ko bahut faayda diya kyunke is ne un ke darmiyaan raaye ka ittehaad aur un ke masail ka khush-gawaar hal yaqeeni banaaya.

Magar Qusai ko qiyaadat aur izzat ke darj-zail imtiyaazaat haasil the: An-Nadwa House ke ijlaason ki sadaarat jahaan sangeen masail se mutalliq mashwaray hote the, aur nikaah ke aqd ka elaan hota tha. Jhanda (The Standard). Us ne jang chhedne se mutalliq maamlaat apne haath mein rakhe. Al-Ka'bah ki darbaani: Woh akela us ka darwaaza kholne ka haqdaar tha, aur us ki khidmat aur hifaazat ka zimmedaar tha. Hujjaaj ke liye paani faraaham karna: Is ka matlab hai ke woh hujjaaj ke peene ke liye khajoor aur kishmish se meethe kiye gaye haouz bharta tha. Hujjaaj ko khilaana: Is ka matlab hai un hujjaaj ke liye khaana banaana jo us ki istetaa'at nahin rakhte the. Qusai ne Quraish par hajj ke mausam mein ada kiya jaane waala saalaana zameeni tax (mehsool) bhi nafaaz kiya, khaane ke liye.

Magar yeh qaabil-e-zikr hai ke Qusai ne 'Abd Manaf ko, apne ek bete ko, izzat aur waqaar ke liye chun liya agarche woh us ka bada beta nahin tha ('Abd Ad-Dar tha), aur use aisi zimmedaariyaan sompeen jaise An-Nadwa House ki sadaarat, jhanda, Al-Ka'bah ki darbaani, hujjaaj ke liye paani aur khaana faraaham karna. Is haqeeqat ki wajah se ke Qusai ke aamaal be-chon-o-chara samjhe jaate the aur uske ahkaamaat na-qaabil-e-khilaaf the, us ki maut ne us ke beton ke darmiyaan koi tanaaza paida nahin kiya, magar baad mein uske poton ke darmiyaan kiya, kyunke 'Abd Munaf ke marte hi, us ke beton ne apne chchere bhaaiyon — 'Abd Ad-Dar ke beton — se jhagde shuru kar diye, jo poore Quraish qabeele ke darmiyaan ikhtilaaf aur jang ka sabab ban jaata, agar ek sulah-naame ki wajah se na hota jis ke zariye ohde dobaara taqseem kiye gaye taa-ke hujjaaj ko khilaana aur paani faraaham karna 'Abd Munaf ke beton ke liye mehfooz rahe; jab ke An-Nadwa House, jhanda aur Al-Ka'bah ki darbaani 'Abd Ad-Dar ke beton ke liye qaaim rakhe gaye.

Magar 'Abd Munaf ke beton ne apni zimmedaari ke liye qura andaazi ki, aur natijatan khaane aur paani dene ki zimmedaari Hashim bin 'Abd Munaf ko chhod di, jis ki maut par, yeh zimmedaari us ke ek bhaai Al-Muttalib bin 'Abd Manaf ne sambhaali aur us ke baad 'Abd Al-Muttalib bin Hashim, Nabi ke daada, ne, jin ke beton ne yeh maqaam Islam ke uruj tak sambhaala, jis ke douraan 'Abbas bin 'Abdul-Muttalib is ke zimmedaar the.

Bahut se doosre ohde Quraish ke logon mein taqseem kiye gaye taa-ke ek naye jamhoori chhote riyaasat ke sutoon qaaim kiye jaayein jis mein aaj ki tarah ke sarkaari daftar aur councils (majaalis) hon. Darj-zail in mein se kuch ohde hain: Buton ke liye qura andaazi Bani Jumah ko di gayi. Nazranon aur qurbaaniyon ko likhna, tanaazaat aur mutalliqa masail ka tasfiya Bani Sahm ke haathon mein tha. Mashwara Bani Asad ko jaata tha. Khoon-baha aur jurmaanon ka intezaam Bani Tayim ke paas tha. Qaumi parcham uthaana Bani Omaiyah ke paas tha. Fauji idaara, paidal aur sawaar dasta Bani Makhzum ki zimmedaari thi. Bani 'Adi bairooni safeeron (mediators) ke taur par kaam karte the.

topics.title: Sare-Arab (Pan-Arabia) mein Hukoomat

paragraphs.text: Hum pehle Qahtanide aur 'Adnanide hijraton, aur in do qabail ke darmiyaan Arab ki taqseem ka zikr kar chuke hain. Woh qabail jo Heerah ke qareeb rehte the, woh Heerah ke Arab baadshah ke taabe the, jab ke woh jo Syrian neem-sehra mein rehte the, woh Arab Ghassanide baadshah ke ghalbe mein the, ek aisi taabedaari jo haqeeqat mein haqeeqi se ziyaada rasmi thi. Magar, woh jo peechhe ke sehraaon mein rehte the, woh poori khud-mukhtaari ka mazaa lete the.
Dar-haqeeqat in qabail ke sardaar poore qabeele ke chune huye hote the jo qabaili yakjehti par mabni ek neem-hukoomat thi aur zameen aur jaaidaad ki hifaazat mein ijtimaai mafaadaat rakhti thi.

Qabail ke sardaaron ko baadshahon jaise aamiraana imtiyaazaat haasil the, aur jang aur aman donon mein un ki poori itaa'at aur taabedaari ki jaati thi. Magar, hukoomat ke liye chchere bhaaiyon ke darmiyaan rashk aksar unhein ek doosre se badh kar mehmaan-nawaazi karne, sakhaawat, hikmat aur muruwwat ka muzaahira karne par maajboor karta tha, sirf is maqsad se ke apne raqeebon se aage nikal jaayein, aur logon mein shohrat haasil karein khaaskar shaairon mein jo us waqt ke sarkaari tarjumaan the.

Qabail ke sardaaron aur aaqaaon ke jang ke maal-e-ghaneemat par khaas haq the jaise maal-e-ghaneemat ka choutha hissa, jo bhi woh apne liye chun le, ya wapsi ke raaste par paaye ya phir baaqi bachi na-qaabil-e-taqseem ghaneemat.

topics.topicSummary: Teen taajdaar saltanaton ke baahar, Arab ke andaroon ilaaqon mein qabail par chune huye qabaili sardaar hukoomat karte the jo baadshah jaisa ikhtiyaar rakhte the. Heerah ya Ghassan par taabedaari ziyaada-tar rasmi thi, jab ke geherey sehra ke qabail poori taur par khud-mukhtaar the. Qabaili sardaar izzat ke liye sakhaawat aur muruwwat ke zariye shadeed muqaabla karte the, jis mein shaair un ke awaami tarjumaan the.

topics.title: Siyaasi Soorat-e-Haal

paragraphs.text: Ghair-mulkiyon se mulhiqa teen Arab ilaaqon ne badi kamzori aur kam-tari ka shikaar rahe. Wahaan ke log ya to aaqa the ya ghulaam, hukmaraan the ya taabe. Aaqaaon, khaaskar ghair-mulkiyon ka, har faayde par haq tha; ghulaamon ke paas zimmedaariyon ke siwa kuch nahin tha jo uthaani parti theen. Doosre lafzon mein, khud-saraana aamiraana hukoomat ne taabe logon ke huqooq par dast-darazi, jahaalat, zulm, na-insaafi, be-insaafi aur takleef paida ki, aur unhein aise log bana diya jo andhere aur jahaalat mein tatol rahe the, yaani, zarkhez zameen jo apne phal hukmaraano aur baa-ikhtiyaar logon ko apni khwaahishon aur lazzaton, hawas aur khwaahishaat, zulm aur jaarihiyat par fazool kharch karne ke liye deti thi.

In ilaaqon ke qareeb rehne waale qabail Syria aur Iraq ke darmiyaan jhoolte rehte the, jab ke woh jo Arab ke andar rehte the woh muntashir the aur qabaili tasaadum aur nasli aur mazhabi tanaazaat ke zer-e-asar the. Un ke paas na to apni khud-mukhtaari barqaraar rakhne ke liye koi baadshah tha aur na hi mushkil waqt mein mashwara lene ya bharosa karne ke liye koi madadgaar.

Magar Hijaz ke hukmaraano ki Arabon mein badi qadr aur ehteraam thi, aur unhein mazhabi markaz ke hukmaraan aur khaadim samjha jaata tha. Hijaz ki hukoomat, dar-haqeeqat, dunyaawi aur sarkaari sabqat ke saath-saath mazhabi qiyaadat ka bhi ek mixture (mil-jul) thi. Woh Arabon mein mazhabi qiyaadat ke naam par hukoomat karte the aur hamesha Bait-ul-Haraam aur uske ird-gird ki tawalliyat par ekaada karte the. Woh Al-Ka'bah ke aane waalon ke mafaadaat ka khayaal rakhte the aur Ibrahim ke qaanoon ko naafiz karne ke zimmedaar the. Un ke paas yahaan tak ke aaj ki parliaments ke jaise ohde aur departments (mehkme) the. Magar, woh is bhaari bojh ko uthaane ke liye bahut kamzor the, jaisa ke yeh Abyssinian (Ethiopian) hamle ke douraan saaf zaahir hua.

topics.topicSummary: Islam se pehle Arab siyaasi taur par muntashir tha — sarhadi ilaaqe ghair-mulki zulm ke neeche the, andaroon qabail tanaazaat se choor the, aur sirf Hijaz ne ek munfarid mazhabi-siyaasi ikhtiyaar barqaraar rakkha. Phir bhi Hijaz ke hukmaraan bhi ghair-mulki taaqaton se difaa ke liye bahut kamzor saabit huye, jis ne ek muttahid karne waali quwwat ki shadeed zaroorat ko ujaagar kiya — jo Islam jald faraaham karne waala tha.
